screenshots.visual_review: Cold-read desktop hierarchy, selected sentence, Regional position heading/key, and all three measures are legible.
Deuteranopia simulation preserves null-state hierarchy and non-color selected/reference identities.
Grayscale simulation preserves hierarchy and color-independent selected/reference identities.
Purpose-scrolled portrait frame clearly shows the visibility group inspection and selected-ring grammar.
Purpose-scrolled inspection frame clearly shows the water peer cursor and exact inspector text; complete cold-read copy is verified in separate cases.
Purpose-scrolled landscape frame preserves the selected sentence and lens entry without horizontal clipping.
Selected-place failure alert is fully readable; desktop legend is absent and exact alert intersections with legend, header, controls, and panel are zero.
Portrait null state clearly distinguishes incomplete/unavailable observations from plotted zero references.
Reduced-motion portrait state preserves hierarchy, plot geometry, and readable selected values.
Effective-200%-reflow proxy keeps the centered measure column, readable values, and all three distributions without horizontal overflow.

self_review.note: Inspection, landscape, reduced-motion, and reflow captures intentionally retain purpose-specific panel scroll positions; separate cold-read cases verify the complete selected sentence and hierarchy.

limitations: MapLibre camera center and zoom are direct development-build getter measurements only for normal map cases; map-failure snapshots explicitly retain source-derived expected camera values because the failed map has no live getter.
History exposes length but no native index; a QA-only pre-app instrumentation records push/replace/pop operations and a document-local tracked index. No production state was added.
Grayscale and deuteranopia are CSS simulations, not assistive-hardware tests.
The 720 CSS-pixel case is the project’s effective-200%-reflow proxy, not an operating-system zoom measurement.
Map failure is induced with a null canvas context, not a live network outage.
No current selected continuous source observation equals exactly zero; null-versus-zero is verified through PN null rendering, retained zero references, and the frontend model/component suite.
Independent scientific/UX/accessibility review and owner visual/interaction acceptance remain required before done.
